(2) The camera shifts to a close-up angle, and the hand rotates the model to reveal the bottom edge. The focus is sharp on a singular, centered cutout intended for a Type-C port, flanked by tiny speaker grille indentations. The physical object appears to be a lightweight plastic prototype with a slightly textured surface. (3) The hand continues to rotate the device, displaying its extremely slim side profile. The camera maintains a medium close-up, capturing the relative thinness of the mock-up compared to the person's thumb. The background remains out of focus, keeping the visual emphasis entirely on the physical dimensions of the object being handled. (4) The person flips the model to show the rear side, which features a faint, debossed apple-shaped logo in the center and a horizontal camera bump housing a single circular lens cutout at the top. The hand moves dynamically to catch the light on the edges of the white material, emphasizing its thin, aerodynamic design before returning to a front-on view.
